Create ONE square image 1254x1254: a 2x2 sheet of four EVOLVED (peak, top-tier, legendary) skill icons for a medieval dark-fantasy turn-based RPG. Reference image 'ref-other-evolves.png' shows other heroes' icons in pairs (left = base skill, right = its evolved form): match the evolved ones in grandeur, richness and format. An evolved icon is the skill's ultimate form: the main object itself is bigger, transformed and more majestic (not just the base icon with extra effects), fills most of its quarter, strong inner glow and bright rim light, rich materials (engraved gold and bronze filigree, carved metal, gem-like glow). Style: painted digital fantasy game icon, crisp clean edges, clean and rich but NOT busy. Background: fully transparent (real alpha) around every icon, NO checkerboard painted in, no scenery, no square tile, no frame. Each icon centred in its own quarter with a margin; nothing touches a quarter edge, nothing spills into a neighbour quarter. ONE clear central subject per icon, strong unique silhouette readable at 36 px, very few sparks or droplets, no grain, no noise, no speckles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no modern objects. The four silhouettes must be clearly different from each other AND from the attached base icons.

Silhouette: hammer inside a ring.
BOTTOM-LEFT 'Second Thunder' (evolved Thunder Strike): a tall rune-carved standing stone (menhir) with glowing blue runes, struck at its top by TWO thick lightning bolts that join into one blinding white-blue flash, small storm cloud above. Silhouette: tall standing stone with forked bolts.
BOTTOM-RIGHT 'Saga of Storms' (evolved War Drum): a grand war drum bound in engraved bronze bands and gold studs, its hide glowing white-blue, three branching lightning bolts erupting upward from the drum skin into a crown of storm cloud above it. Silhouette: drum with a lightning fan above.
